caption:
You measure your faith by how much you do. But what if it was never about doing more—only about how you see people? (Galatians 2:1-2 devotional)

You measure faith by how much you do, while quietly sorting people by rank — measuring others the way you feared being measured. But real faith is whether the gospel changed your gaze; the centurion looked at his slave and called him “my child.” Christ is your peace and has already torn down the dividing wall, so you no longer rank people — you belong with them.
